title: Técnico(a) Mecânico III
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up , o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência

Desafios

Liderar e executar atividades complexas de manutenção mecânica preventiva e corretiva nos equipamentos e sistemas das áreas de Recuperação (Caldeiras de Recuperação, Evaporação, Caustificação, Forno de Cal e Gaseificação) e Utilidades (caldeiras de força, turbinas, sistemas de tratamento de água, ar comprimido, vapor, Eta, Ete, Etac, Captação e Emissãrio) da fábrica de celulose, diagnosticando falhas críticas, desenvolvendo soluções técnicas avançadas, liderando equipes em intervenções, garantindo a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança dos ativos, seguindo planos, procedimentos, normas de segurança e contribuindo para a otimização da eficiência operacional.

Principais atividades

  • Planejar, executar e supervisionar manutenções preventivas e corretivas de alta complexidade em equipamentos das áreas de Recuperação e Utilidades;
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas críticas, definindo planos de reparo e liderando intervenções técnicas complexas;
  • Conduzir análises de falhas (RCA) e propor melhorias técnicas para aumento da confiabilidade e performance dos equipamentos;
  • Interpretar desenhos técnicos mecânicos, diagramas hidráulicos e pneumáticos, além de elaborar planos e procedimentos de manutenção;
  • Liderar projetos de melhoria, montagem, comissionamento e testes de equipamentos.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos de manutenção, análises de falhas e recomendações para otimização dos processos;
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe, treinando e orientando técnicos mecânicos I e II;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança, APR, procedimentos operacionais e uso de EPIs;
  • Registrar e analisar atividades em sistemas de gestão de manutenção (CMMS), identificando tendências e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas multidisciplinares, contribuindo para soluções e estratégias de manutenção;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas de Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Segurança, Saúde Ocupacional, Ética e Compliance.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Curso Técnico em Mecânica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Integração Segurança;
  • Ferramentas da qualidade;
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Conhecimento avançado em mecânica industrial (elementos de máquinas, lubrificação industrial especializada, sistemas hidráulicos e pneumáticos complexos, transmissão de potência, termodinâmica básica);
  • Leitura e interpretação avançada de desenhos técnicos mecânicos detalhados, diagramas complexos e manuais de equipamentos especializados;
  • Conhecimento avançado em alinhamento de equipamentos (laser e convêncional), balanceamento dinâmico, análise de vibração e outras técnicas de manutenção preditiva;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em normas de segurança do trabalho (NR-13, NR-33, NR-35) e legislação pertinente;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos processos de Recuperação (caldeiras de recuperação, evaporadores, tratamento de gases, WLP e gaseificação) e Utilidades (caldeiras de força, turbinas, sistemas de tratamento de água, Etac, Eta, Ete, Captação e Emissãrio) na indústria de celulose;
  • CNH – Categoria “B”.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em diagnóstico avançado de falhas mecânicas, utilizando instrumentos de medição de alta precisão e técnicas de análise (análise de vibração avançada, termografia, análise de óleo);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão da manutenção (CMMS) e análise de dados de manutenção.

Se você acredita que excelência técnica, segurança e inovação constroem operações de referência mundial, este desafio é para você. Inscreva-se e venha fazer parte do Projeto Sucuriú, a grandeza que abraça.

title: DevOps Specialist
description:
ESPECIALISTA DEVOPS

Qual o desafio?

Buscamos um Especialista DevOps, que não apenas domine as ferramentas e práticas de automação, mas que tenha um profundo entendimento de que cada linha de código e cada processo de pipeline impacta diretamente na nossa postura de segurança. Você não será apenas um executor de tarefas, mas um(a) parceiro(a) estratégico(a) na evolução da nossa infraestrutura, garantindo que a inovação e a segurança caminhem lado a lado.

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e Manter a Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Utilizar ferramentas como Terraform e Ansible para provisionar, configurar e gerenciar nossa infraestrutura em ambientes multi-cloud (Huawei, Azure, GCP), garantindo que todos os recursos sejam versionados e auditáveis.
  • Orquestração e Gerenciamento de Contêineres: Projetar, implementar e sustentar clusters Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) robustos e seguros, gerenciando o ciclo de vida de aplicações conteinerizadas.
  • Automação de Pipelines CI/CD: Criar e otimizar pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD) com AzureDevOps, GitLab CI ou ferramenta similar, integrando etapas de análise de segurança estática (SAST), dinâmica (DAST) e de composição de software (SCA) diretamente no fluxo de desenvolvimento.
  • Monitoramento, Observabilidade e Resposta a Incidentes: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) para garantir a saúde, performance e segurança dos nossos serviços. Atuar de forma proativa na identificação e mitigação de anomalias e ser peça-chave na resposta a incidentes de segurança.
  • Fortalecer a Cultura DevSecOps: Colaborar ativamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento e segurança para disseminar as melhores práticas de "security by design". Você será um evangelizador da segurança em todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software.
  • Gerenciamento de Custos em Nuvem (FinOps): Analisar o consumo de recursos na nuvem e propor otimizações contínuas para garantir a eficiência de custos sem comprometer a performance e a segurança.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Sólida Experiência (mínimo de 5 anos) em DevOps/SRE: Vivência comprovada em ambientes de produção de alta criticidade.
  • Proficiência em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Domínio de Terraform e/ou CloudFormation.
  • Expertise em Orquestração de Contêineres: Experiência prática e aprofundada com Kubernetes e Docker em produção.
  • Mestria em Automação de CI/CD: Amplo conhecimento na construção e manutenção de pipelines com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI, ou Azure DevOps.
  • Scripting e Automação: Fluência em linguagens como Python, Go ou Bash.
  • Conhecimento em Provedores de Nuvem: Experiência significativa com pelo menos um dos grandes provedores (Huawei, Azure ou GCP).
  • Mentalidade de Segurança: Conhecimento prático sobre os princípios de segurança em nuvem, redes e aplicações.

O que seria muito legal se você soubesse:

  • Certificações em provedores de nuvem (Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert) ou em Kubernetes (CKA, CKS) são um grande diferencial.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SAST, DAST, e segurança de contêineres (Aqua Security, Trivy).
  • Experiência em empresas que seguem padrões como ISO 27001, SOC 2 ou PCI-DSS.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Inglês intermediário

Auxiliar nas atividades relacionadas as exigências e indeferimentos.

title: Acquisition Editor, Life Science
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators, and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching, and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Universidad de São Paulo, Universidade Estadual Paulista, Fundação Oswaldo Fiocruz and more. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India, servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.

Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.

Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: In-house Engineer
description:
Role: In-house Engineer

Global Opportunities

By joining a team of more than 7,000 people operating in over 60 countries, you will be part of an agile network of talented and ambitious individuals. We count on you to engage, connect, and collaborate with colleagues from around the world. Seize the opportunity to learn, create, and develop your potential with us.

You will be part of the Brazil Field Service team. Our department is responsible for providing first-class field service and support 24/7. By joining us, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical and interpersonal skills through diverse and challenging opportunities.

About the Role: In-house Engineer

As our In-house Engineer, you will be part of a highly qualified team and will be responsible for providing technical and commercial support to our customers directly at their sites.

We currently have four openings available.

Candidates must be based in, or willing to relocate to, one of the following locations

or nearby areas:

  • Nova Lima, MG
  • Santa Bárbara, MG
  • Parauapebas, PA
  • Canaã dos Carajás, PA,
  • Belém, PA

Your Responsibilities

  • Work full-time at designated customer sites.
  • Serve as the FLS focal point at the customer’s site.
  • Coordinate the resolution of all open items between FLS and the customer, ensuring effective and timely closure.
  • Provide on-site basic technical and commercial support to assist customers in achieving maximum operational efficiency with their FLS equipment, including filters, thickeners, flotation cells, crushers, HPGRs, and mills.
  • Monitor the customer’s inventory as well as all other key operational aspects to ensure safe and reliable operations.
  • Relay updated technical and commercial information from the customer site to FLS customer support teams.
  • Support the customer and the FLS team during scheduled and emergency maintenance activities at site.
  • Identify, evaluate, and recommend products, parts, upgrades, and services that best meet customer needs.
  • Ensure the entire sales process aligns with customer requirements,
  • from the initial proposal to final delivery, within the agreed timeframe.
  • Develop strong and effective relationships and communication with customers.
  • Deliver technical and administrative field reports.
  • Maintain and update the CRM system and other control tools.
  • Promote a culture of personal and team/customer safety.
  • Work independently with limited supervision

What You Bring

  • Technical degree or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in the mining industry (desirable).
  • Good working knowledge of parts and maintenance of mining equipment such as Thickeners, Flotation Cells, Filters, HPGRs, Mills and Crushers
  • Intermediate English and/or Spanish (desirable).
  • Availability to reside in or near the cities listed above.
  • Availability to travel when required.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Solid knowledge of MS Office, Outlook, and CRM systems.

What We Offer

  • Market-competitive salary and benefits package
  • Health insurance.
  • Meal vouchers.
  • Bonus program.
  • Private pension plan.
  • Internal and international opportunities to develop your career.

As an equal opportunity employer, FLSmidth embraces diversity and equality, promoting an inclusive environment. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees, the stronger our team. In our commitment to equal opportunities and the elimination of prejudice, we ask that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, number of children and photograph from your application materials.

Please note that we will be reviewing applications till March 30th, but the procees is going forward at he same time and can be closed earlier. so please apply as early as possible. Candidates will be contacted by email and phone.

References from unsolicited recruiters or agencies will not be accepted.

All applicants will be required to pass a medical, drug and alcohol test prior to employment.

FLSmidth requires that all individuals have their respective work visas. Otherwise, we will not be able to accept your application.

FLSmidth is the leading supplier of engineering, equipment and service solutions to customers in the mining industry – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers

title: Structuring Sr. Analyst
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Portfolio Support

  • Ongoing oversight of existing investments, including contract enforcement, regulatory updates, risk mitigation and management report.
  • Support portfolio management such as quotaholders’ meetings discussions and approvals, monitoring existing portfolio, solving structuring and portfolio matters through creative solutions and facilitating collaboration with external third parties, Local teams and Global teams, as needed; and
  • Maintain fluid communication with Local and Global teams, external service providers and originators to ensure alignment on portfolio health.

Deal Flow Support

  • Support the team reviewing, and negotiating investment agreements, ensuring full alignment with Credit Committee approvals and regulatory requirements.
  • Support the team in coordinating legal and structuring analysis for new opportunities, identifying potential "red flags" and proposing mitigation structures.
  • Support team in preparing materials for the Credit Committee, ensuring that the legal risks and structural safeguards of every deal are clearly communicated.
  • Act as a point of contact for external legal advisors, fund managers, and originators to ensure timely and cost-effective closing of new deals; and
  • Maintain fluid communication with Lending and Credit Risk teams to ensure that new deal structures are not only legally robust but also commercially viable and tax-efficiency

General Support

  • Supporting and coordinating cross-functional structuring initiatives, improving reporting and monitoring structures and periodically routines with stakeholders.
  • Support the team in addressing and clarifying matters that may arise from new investments and/or existing portfolios.
  • Support knowledge sharing and internal development initiatives through the preparation of materials or participation in training activities.

Requirements

  • 3 to 5 years of experience as a lawyer in securitized environment, credit operations, including capital markets transactions such Debentures, CRIs/CRAs and FIDCs.
  • Has worked as in-house counsel, in a top law firm and/or in a fund manager or fund administrator.
  • Bachelor’s degree in law.
  • Duly registered with the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB).
  • Strong ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Clear and objective communication skills for interaction with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Excellent legal and structuring technical skills, organized and strong attention to detail.
  • Experience with credit lifecycle process and delinquency/collection management is a strong plus.
  • Familiar with Excel spreadsheets.
  • Solid interpersonal and collaborative abilities.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care, and body care brands.

At Coty, we celebrate and nurture a culture of kindness. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and believe that beauty lies in diversity. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where all talents can shine and where different perspectives drive innovation and growth.

JOB OVERVIEW

Lead and oversee all Facilities operations across Corporate Offices, R&D Labs, Manufacturing Plant, and Distribution Center, ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective infrastructure. Drive operational excellence through strong vendor management, robust maintenance programs, and continuous improvement. Act as the key connection between local operations and global standards for EHS, Engineering, and Sustainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a strong safety culture and full compliance with legal requirements, NRs, company HSE policies, and global corporate standards.
  • Guarantee the integrity, reliability, and availability of all facilities infrastructure, including utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, water treatment, fire protection, building automation, and critical assets.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee internal and outsourced teams (maintenance, cleaning, security, reception, gardening, cafeteria, and services).
  • Manage preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance programs, ensuring uptime and operational continuity for Office, R&D Labs, Manufacturing, and Distribution Center.
  • Oversee facilities services to ensure high service levels, cost efficiency, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives to enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, waste reduction, and operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with certifications, internal audits, external audits, and global standards (ISO, GMP where applicable).
  • Oversee space planning, workplace strategy, building layout updates, and occupancy optimization.
  • Manage construction projects, renovations, expansions, and infrastructure modifications from planning to delivery, ensuring alignment with Capex governance.
  • Coordinate incident management, emergency response plans, fire brigade activities, and building security protocols.
  • Monitor and manage facilities KPIs, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage Opex and Capex budgets, ensuring cost optimization and adherence to financial targets.
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, HR, IT, Security, Finance) to ensure seamless and compliant operations.
  • Ensure vendor management excellence, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for facilities matters with local leadership and global functional teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience managing Facilities operations across multi-site or complex environments (Office, Industrial, Logistics, or R&D).
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, or facilities services.
  • Strong technical background in building systems (HVAC, electrical, utilities, fire systems).
  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance management, vendor management, and project leadership.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.
  • Proven experience in managing Capex and Opex budgets.
  • Experience in multinational environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

title: LLM Application Engineer
description:
The Role

You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources
  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection
  • Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications
  • Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems
  • Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available
  • Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically
  • Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.

What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

  • Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.
  • Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it
  • Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management
  • Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)
  • Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging
  • Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)
  • Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings
  • Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services
  • Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric , Power BI , or Azure ecosystem

Why This Role

  • Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.
  • Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.
  • Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.
  • Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

Atuar de forma técnica e analítica nos processos fiscais relacionados a tributos indiretos, impostos retidos, precificação tributária e conciliações fiscais, garantindo conformidade, integridade das informações e suporte às áreas internas. Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em Contabilidade, Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em tributos indiretos e impostos retidos.
  • Vivência com SPEDs, REINF, conciliações contábeis e interação com auditorias.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Descrição da Empresa

Na Vigor Energy, nós impulsionamos a transição energética entregando economia, tecnologia e sustentabilidade. Atuamos com excelência no mercado de energia solar, garantindo que nossos clientes tenham a melhor experiência e verdadeira liberdade financeira. Você será o(a) líder estratégico(a) da nossa equipe administrativa, supervisionando diretamente o time de analistas responsáveis pelo suporte técnico, faturamento e pós-venda financeiro. Sua missão é garantir a fluidez dos processos diários, a exatidão das análises de faturas e rateios, e o mais alto nível de excelência no atendimento e resolução de dúvidas do consumidor final.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe: Gerenciar, treinar e orientar o time de analistas, conduzindo reuniões de alinhamento, aplicando feedbacks contínuos (1:1s) e garantindo um alto nível de motivação e produtividade.
  • Gestão de Faturamento e Compensação: Supervisionar as rotinas de análise aprofundada de faturas de energia, chancelando a precisão dos cálculos de rateio, injeção de excedentes e regras sistêmicas de compensação de energia elétrica.
  • Sucesso do Cliente (Pós-Venda): Atuar como ponto focal e de escalonamento para o atendimento de dúvidas mais complexas dos consumidores, assegurando a resolução de inconsistências junto às distribuidoras de energia e mantendo a qualidade no suporte técnico.
  • Monitoramento de Indicadores (KPIs): Elaborar e acompanhar planilhas e dashboards gerenciais focados em indicadores como SLA de tempo de resposta, precisão do faturamento (evitando bitributação ou erros) e métricas de satisfação do cliente, fornecendo dados para a tomada de decisão da diretoria.
  • Estruturação de Processos: Criar, documentar e otimizar os fluxos de trabalho administrativos, garantindo o uso eficiente das ferramentas de gestão (ERP/CRM) e a correta alimentação de dados do setor.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Ensino Superior completo (ou em fase final) em Engenharia Eletrica, Administração de Empresas, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão Financeira, Economia ou áreas correlatas com forte apelo analítico.
  • Experiência em Gestão: Vivência comprovada na liderança e supervisão de equipes administrativas, de faturamento, suporte ou operações de pós-venda.
  • Domínio do Setor Elétrico: É indispensável possuir conhecimento prático das normativas de Geração Distribuída (GD), leitura técnica de contas de luz e mecânica do Sistema de Compensação de Energia Elétrica (SCEE).

  • Habilidades de comunicação e atendimento ao cliente: É necessário possuir habilidade em comunicação clara e eficiente, tanto verbal quanto escrita, além de experiência em atendimento a clientes, sempre garantindo um serviço de qualidade.

  • Gestão orçamentária: Conhecimento sólido em orçamento, incluindo análise e controle financeiro, é essencial.

Experience with e-Procurement and e-Sourcing tools.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

São Paulo – São Paulo – Brazil – Hybrid (Vila Olimpía)

Who We Are

Intrials is a disruptive company with all the attributes that a CRO must master. We mix innovative projects with the necessary skills to provide a full service. Nothing stops us in the search for knowledge. Transforming people's lives through science when it comes to solving the challenges of our clients' projects in a focused and exclusive fashion.

Diversity & Inclusion are essential to continue building our history of innovation. Diversity of color, belief, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristic are very welcome in all open positions at our company. It is a fundamental part of Intrials to constantly think and implement actions that reinforce the importance of good coexistence with all the people who are part of our DNA and together, to leverage and build true impactful results in our society.

Basic Functions and Responsibilities includes, but are not limited to :

▪ Clinical Study Management: Manage clinical studies from study planning and set-up to study closure, following contract requirements.

▪ Budget and Timeline Management: Ownership and Oversight of the the budgets and timelines specified in the clinical study contract.

▪ Oversight of Functions: Provide oversight of other functions, including Clinical, Safety, Regulatory & Start-up, and Vendor Management.

▪ Business Development: Contribute to business development in the preparation of proposals (BIDs), and portfolio management activities.

▪ Customer Relationship: Act as the Intrials representative and primary point of contact with the Sponsor for the clinical study. Take ownership of the customer relationship throughout the project and drive the resolution of customer issues.

▪ Compliance: Ensure that study activities are conducted in compliance with Intrials quality standards, Intrials and/or Sponsor’s SOPs, GCP-ICH guidelines, and local and international regulations.

▪ Protocol and Training: Maintain an in-depth knowledge of the protocol, therapeutic area, and indication. Participate in study-related training to the Intrials clinical operations team involved in the study, offering regular support on various aspects such as protocol, monitoring plan, recruitment plan, CRF, monitoring tools, and study systems.

▪ Project Planning: Develop and review operational project plans in collaboration with the clinical study team. This includes Monitoring Plans, Communication Plans, Project Management Plans, Risk Management Plans, and others. Ensure that the study is executed in accordance with all established plans.

▪ Monitoring Quality: Ensure the overall quality of monitoring activities Identify and escalate significant issues reported by Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) and Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) to the Sponsor, and follows up until issue is resolved.

▪ Supplies and Materials: Take proper measures to ensure the adequate provisioning of supplies, devices, and materials required for the study, adhering to study specifications.

▪ Collaboration: Collaborate with other departments within the company to support milestone achievement and effectively manage study-related issues and obstacles.

▪ Advanced Risk Management: Identify, assess and develop mitigation strategies for risks in studies, together with the quality Department of Intrials

▪ Strategic Leadership: Lead the formulation and review of processes in collaboration with leaders from other functions, demonstrating leadership and strategic decision-making skills.

▪ Business Development: Actively participate in business proposals and portfolio development activities, including identifying new business opportunities and expanding relationships with existing sponsors.

▪ Complex Problem Solving: Managing and resolving study or client issues, requiring negotiation and conflict resolution skills.

▪ Additional Duties: The Project Manager may be assigned other duties to ensure completion of company objectives.

Primary Activities includes, but are not limited to:

▪ Regular communication with Sponsor in order to support the definition of the study design and the best strategy for project implementation in the countries covered by Intrials operations;

▪ Regular contact with other departments within the company to support milestone achievement and to manage study issues and obstacles;

▪ Establish an enthusiastic work environment and a motivated project team, encouraging open communication and ensuring high-quality work;

▪ Manage the feasibility process, supporting the approach, identification, and selection of sites to clinical study;

▪ Develop integrated study management plans with the core project team;

▪ Keep close contact with Sponsors / Investigators; ▪ Co-organize / conduct / participate in investigators meetings / other project related meetings (face-to-face or teleconference) according to Sponsor alignment;

▪ Organize / conduct meetings with Intrials study team at regular basis/whenever needed;

▪ Organize / conduct meetings with the Sponsor according to study project and Sponsor’s request;

▪ Provide support to CRAs, CTM and team at regular basis (protocol, monitoring plan, recruitment plan, CRF, monitoring tools, study systems, etc.);

▪ Assume and support monitoring activities whenever necessary;

▪ Oversee daily activities of operational team to ensure focus on quality and timelines;

▪ Ensure high quality level in data collection and queries resolution;

▪ Coordinate study activities with CRAs and CTM, including pre-selection visits, initiation visits, CRA training, recruitment, interim monitoring visits and close-out activities;

▪ Ensure study is conducted in compliance with all study plans;

▪ Ensure adequate provisioning of supplies, devices, and materials in the study, according to study requirements;

▪ Prepare / review study status tools (newsletters, recruitment status, periodic report, etc.) whenever needed or requested by the Sponsor;

▪ Identify and record non-conformity and provide preventive actions supported by Intrials QA department;

▪ Track study metrics and milestones to guarantee that the project is being conducted according to Sponsor’s requirements;

▪ Prepare / support contract and negotiate budget with study sites;

▪ Ensure study documentation is properly maintained and archived in eTMF / TMF and databases, as applicable;

▪ Ensure overall monitoring quality by reviewing and evaluating monitoring visits reports, detecting issues, resolving and/or escalating issues reported by CRAs;

▪ Manage risks and contingencies proactively and lead problem solving and resolution efforts;

▪ Mitigate risks with action plans in place as agreed with upper management and / or the Sponsor; ▪ Provide support to on-site audits and inspections;

▪ Review SOPs related to the department activities;

▪ Attend courses / meetings in order to improve / acquire new skills;

▪ Share lessons learned with the team and ensure adequate deployment of possible identified action plans;

▪ Prepare revenue reports own projects and revenue forecast.

Skills:

▪ University Degree (preferably in the health science area such as Pharmacy, Biology, Biomedicine, Nursing, Medicine, other);

▪ In depth understanding of Clinical Research industry (drug/device/technology/etc.) and the relevant environments in which it operates;

▪ Reliable and demonstrable professional experience;

▪ Good organizational, communication and interpersonal relationships;

▪ In-depth knowledge of ICH-GCP, national and international regulations;

▪ Training/presentation skills

▪ Fluency in English;

▪ Basic Spanish is highly recommended;

▪ Computer skills on Windows and Microsoft Office tools.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
Sobre a vaga:

O Candidato de Staff Data Engineer, ficará alocado(a) no Banco John Deere, você será responsável por atuar como liderança técnica da plataforma de dados, definindo arquitetura, padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de dados que garantam escala, governança, confiabilidade e sustentabilidade das soluções de dados. Você atuará de forma transversal, apoiando múltiplos times e produtos, sendo referência técnica em decisões estratégicas de dados, trabalhando em parceria com Engineering Managers, Product Managers e áreas de negócio. Esta é uma posição Individual Contributor, com forte impacto organizacional e foco em longo prazo.

As responsabilidades de Staff Data Engineer incluem:

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura da plataforma de dados, incluindo ingestão, transformação, armazenamento e consumo;
  • Estabelecer padrões técnicos e boas práticas de engenharia de dados para uso por múltiplos times;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para engenheiros de dados, apoiando decisões arquiteturais e promovendo mentoria;
  • Conduzir decisões técnicas relacionadas a escalabilidade, custo, governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados;
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima a Engineering Managers e Product Managers para alinhar soluções de dados às necessidades do negócio e requisitos regulatórios;
  • Resolver problemas técnicos complexos e sistêmicos que impactam múltiplos pipelines, domínios ou produtos de dados;
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da estratégia de dados do Banco John Deere.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa ou equivalente em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima em progressiva em engenharia de dados, com trajetória consistente;
  • Experiência comprovada em mentoria e liderança técnica de outros engenheiros;
  • Atuar como autoridade técnica na resolução de problemas complexos de engenharia de dados;
  • Conhecimento de Arquitetura e Plataforma de Dados;
  • Experiência com Engenharia e Processamento de Dados (ingestão, transformação, orquestração, processamento em larga escala);
  • Conhecimento em Governança, Qualidade, Lineage, Segurança e Conformidade de Dados;
  • Domínio avançado de Cloud e Infraestrutura para Dados (plataformas em cloud, otimização de custos, resiliência operacional);
  • Domínio avançado de AWS (Amazon Web Services), com foco em S3 (Simple Storage Service) e Data Lake;
  • Experiência com AWS DMS (Data Migration Service);
  • Experiência com Databricks e Apache Spark;
  • Conhecimento de SQL (Structured Query Language) avançado e Bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, AWS);
  • Experiência com Modelagem e transformação de dados para consumo analítico;
  • Conhecimento em Escalabilidade e estratégias de entrega de dados (batch, streaming, near real-time);

O Que Faz Você se Destacar:

  • Ter definido padrões ou arquiteturas de dados utilizados por mais de um time ou produto;
  • Experiência com governança de dados, incluindo qualidade, lineage, versionamento e auditoria;
  • Histórico de decisões técnicas que impactaram custo, escalabilidade ou confiabilidade da plataforma de dados;
  • Vivência em ambientes regulados (financeiro, crédito, risco, compliance ou similares);
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções de dados simples, escaláveis e sustentáveis.

  • Sólido conhecimento em sistemas ERP, especialmente TOTVS Protheus, incluindo módulos como Financeiro, RH, Produção, Compras, Vendas e Estoque;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL Server, integrações sistêmicas e entendimento básico de ADVPL;
  • Familiaridade com processos de negócios industriais (planejamento de produção, ordens de produção, listas de materiais, custos, gestão de estoque);
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas, com atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação, com capacidade de interagir eficazmente com usuários de negócios, equipe de TI e fornecedores externos;
  • Experiência na gestão de equipes de suporte e coordenação de atividades relacionadas a sistemas;
  • Conhecimento de princípios ITIL e práticas ITSM é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em normas legais aplicadas a área de Finanças e RH;

Responsabilidades:

  • Supervisionar a administração, manutenção e suporte do ERP Protheus e de outros sistemas críticos de negócios, incluindo sistemas de chão de fábrica e sistemas auxiliares;
  • Gerenciar controles de acesso de usuários, configurações do sistema e definições de segurança em conformidade com as políticas organizacionais;
  • Monitorar e garantir a adesão às melhores práticas de ITSM, incluindo acompanhamento de solicitações/incidentes e processos de gestão de mudanças;
  • Coordenar atualizações, correções e upgrades dos sistemas em parceria com a equipe de TI e fornecedores externos;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os usuários de negócios para coletar requisitos e traduzi-los em soluções sistêmicas inovadoras;
  • Supervisionar o pessoal de TI, fornecendo orientação diária, atribuição de tarefas e monitoramento do progresso dos projetos;
  • Coordenar com fornecedores de tecnologia, prestadores de serviços e consultores para atividades de suporte e manutenção;

title: Energy Storage Operation and Maintenance Service Plan Engineer
description:

Contemporary Amperex Technology (USA), Inc. Established in Michigan in 2017, CATU has played a critical role in advancing electric mobility and energy resilience in the U.S.

To become a globally leading innovative technology corporation, contribute meaningfully to sustainable energy solutions, and provide a platform that supports both the professional and personal growth of our employees.

Compensation & Benefits

  1. Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  2. Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  3. 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  4. Paid time off and company holidays.
  5. Professional development and growth opportunities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

CATU is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employment Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. CATU reserves the right to modify, revise, or add job responsibilities as business needs evolve. Employment with CATU is at-will, meaning either the employee or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

title: Gestor(a) de Commodities
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gestor(a) de Commodities para atuar no nosso time Comercial.

Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Gerir a mesa de derivativos, assegurando aderência das operações em mercados futuros à política de riscos da Tereos, bem como das análises que embasam as decisões comerciais de arbitragens;
  • Responsável pela execução de operações na mesa de derivativos de açúcar, pelo controle e gestão da exposição Tereos nas bolsas, pelo desenvolvimento de análises de tendências de preços, de arbitragens e de riscos de mercado;
  • Suportar o comitê de riscos com análises de técnicas e fundamentalistas de mercado em alinhamento com o time de Research com o objetivo de maximizar resultados e reduzir riscos;
  • Garantir o alinhamento do livro de futuros ao planejamento de vendas indexadas às bolsas (B2B e Exportação);
  • Realizar o monitoramento e projeção dos indicadores de arbitragem da Tereos;
  • Garantir o desenvolvimento de análises de riscos necessárias para assegurar a qualidade das decisões;
  • Assegurar aderência das fixações ao plano de vendas;
  • Participar das decisões de precificação (Hedge) do açúcar na bolsa em NY, Londres, Etanol, CBio;
  • Suportar a área financeira na definição das corretoras e/ou bancos com as quais a empresa ira operar, negociando limites de crédito, os valores de corretagem e taxas de juros contratuais.

Quais os requisitos?

  • Conhecimento avançado em derivativos agrícolas, energéticos e financeiros;
  • Forte embasamento em modelagens determinísticas e estatísticas;
  • Forte embasamento macroeconômico e em finanças;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Inglês Fluente.

Qual localidade?

São José do Rio Preto - SP

title: Travel Designer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Travel Designer to plan and execute highly curated itineraries for a sophisticated and growing global clientele.

This is a client-facing role focused on delivering seamless, personalized service. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of luxury hospitality, understands the expectations of affluent travelers, and can manage multiple requests while transforming travel inspiration into flawlessly executed journeys.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams and trusted global partners to ensure every trip reflects the highest standards of luxury and service.

Profile

You are passionate about travel, detail-oriented, and skilled at building strong relationships with discerning clients. You intuitively understand their preferences and expectations, delivering highly personalized journeys with professionalism and care. Every interaction you lead reflects a refined standard of luxury service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bespoke, end-to-end itineraries tailored to each client’s travel style and preferences
  • Create and maintain long-term client relationships through prompt, thoughtful communication and flawless planning experience
  • Provide expert destination guidance with a strong understanding of luxury hospitality standards
  • Oversee all aspects of trip planning, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and seamless execution

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in luxury travel design, high-end hospitality, concierge, account management, or another sector within the luxury industry
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus)
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple complex itineraries in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining exceptional service standards
  • CV in English

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:
We are looking for a motivated and hands-on HR Assistant to join our team in Brazil. This role is ideal for an HR professional with generalist experience in a manufacturing environment who enjoys working in a dynamic and multicultural business.

You will support the full spectrum of HR activities, working closely with local management and regional HR teams to ensure smooth HR operations and a positive employee experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support daily HR operations and administration , including employee records and HR documentation
  • Assist with recruitment activities , including job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination, and onboarding
  • Serve as a point of contact for employees regarding HR policies, procedures, and workplace matters
  • Ensure HR processes comply with local labor regulations and company policies
  • Support payroll preparation and coordination with payroll providers
  • Assist with employee engagement initiatives, performance management, and training programs
  • Participate in HR projects and initiatives to improve HR processes and employee experience

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in an HR generalist or HR officer role
  • Experience in the manufacturing industry is highly preferred
  • Previous experience in a multinational company environment (MNC) is an advantage
  • Good understanding of Brazilian labor laws and HR practices
  • Strong organizational and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Education & Language

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
  • Fluent Portuguese and good command of English

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to work in an international and collaborative environment
  • Exposure to regional HR practices and projects
  • A chance to grow your HR career within a dynamic organization

title: Data Scientist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career! Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Data Scientist with a strong focus on Generative AI, capable of designing, developing, and evolving solutions based on LLMs, intelligent agents, and cognitive automations. This professional will work in the creation of agent architecture, integration with corporate data, construction of automated service and decision support flows, in addition to the continuous experimentation of generative models applied to real business problems.

The role requires a combination of data science, applied engineering, prompt engineering, RAG, and agent orchestration, with practical insight into how to scale GenAI solutions in a secure, governed, and measurable way.

Responsibilities

§ Design and implement Generative AI solutions based on LLMs for customer service, operational support, and process automation.

§ Develop and orchestrate AI agents (single-agent and multi-agent), with decision-making, planning, and task execution capabilities.

§ Build RAGE (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines by integrating LLMs into structured and unstructured foundations.

§ Develop and optimize prompts, chunking strategies, embeddings, and semantic retrieval.

§ Integrate agents and generative models with automation workflows, APIs, legacy systems, and fulfillment platforms.

§ Evaluate quality, safety, and performance of GenAI solutions (hallucination, groundedness, latency, cost).

§ Apply statistical and machine learning concepts for evaluation, experimentation, and continuous improvement of solutions.

§ Work together with data, engineering, product, UX, and business teams to evolve solutions.

§ Support the definition of standards, good practices, and governance for the use of Generative AI in a corporate environment.

Hard Skills

§ Solid experience with Generative AI and LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent).

§ Development of AI agents and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel or similar).

§ Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vectors, and vector bases.

§ Strong Python domain and integration via APIs.

§ Knowledge in Machine Learning and fundamentals of applied statistics.

§ Experience with intelligent automations and integration with corporate systems.

§ Knowledge of cloud architecture (Azure, AWS or GCP).

§ Notions of MLOps / LLMOps (versioning, monitoring, evaluation and costs).

Soft Skills

§ Experimental and innovation-oriented mindset.

§ Ability to transform business problems into solutions with agents and GenAI.

§ Clear communication with technical and executive stakeholders.

§ Autonomy, sense of ownership and continuous learning.

§ Collaboration in multidisciplinary teams.

Differentials

§ Experience with corporate copilots, advanced chatbots, and virtual assistants.

§ Experience in customer service automation or Backoffice projects with AI.

§ Knowledge in AI governance, security, and ethics.

§ Experience with advanced LLM evaluation (A/B testing, human feedback, custom metrics).

§ Previous experience in regulated environments (banking, insurance, health, energy).

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: 2nd Mate Officer - Oficial de Náutica (2º Oficial)
description:
Airswift busca para cliente do setor O&G: 2nd Mate Officer para projeto de 9 meses.

Min. Qualifications:

Nautical Institute DP Operator’s Certificate (for DP Vessels only)

STCW95 Reg.

II/1 – OICNW

VI/I Basic Training

VI/6 – Security Training for Seafarers with Security Duties

Valid Medical Certificate of Fitness

II/1 – Generic and Type-Specific ECDIS training (for vessels with ECDIS)

Recommended Experience:

360 Days Sea Time documented as OICNW of which 180 days must be as OICNW on vessels engaged in offshore construction operations. This requirement may be waived by the Manager of Global Marine.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for Navigation, DP or anchor operations when on duty
  • Responsible to maintain current log books on all operations such as vessel movements, helicopter and boat arrivals and departures, deck activities, incidents and accidents
  • Responsible for maintaining the bridge in an orderly and professional manner
  • Responsible for updating navigational publications and charts when appointed in name by the Master
  • Responsible for preparation of manifests for helicopters and supply vessels
  • Assist in planned maintenance of safety equipment, deck equipment and miscellaneous navigational equipment
  • Perform duties in connection with the GMDSS installation
  • Carry out duties and responsibilities as laid down in the Shipboard Oil Pollution Emergency Plan (SOPEP)
  • Oversee deck operations and crane operations with reference to overall vessel operational requirements
  • To be familiar with all Company procedures, including the Safety Management System, applicable to his duties
  • Responsible for refusing unsafe work and for carrying out all work in accordance with the established safety standards and work practices.
  • Taking part in emergency and occupational onboard training such as, the use of self-contained breathing apparatus, firefighting, man overboard exercises, lifeboat launching, security drills and/or other training as applicable for the function

title: Supervisor de Enfermagem - Unidade de Internação Pediátrica Oncológica
description:
Requisitos:

- Superior completo em Enfermagem;

-Pós graduação em área assistencial;

-COREN ativo e dentro da validade;

-Necessário boa vivência com gestão de equipes, experiência na área assistencial, com oncologia pediátrica.

Atividades:

- Tomar ciência, diariamente, das orientações constantes do livro de Ordens e Ocorrências e demais anotações, a fim de tomar ciência das intercorrências ocorridas no plantão diurno possibilitando dar continuidade aos tratamentos dos pacientes;

- Com base na escala mensal de funcionários, recebida da Gerência de Enfermagem, conferir diariamente a presença, atrasos, licença médicas e trocas de plantão realizado pelos funcionários, anotando no livro de ordens e ocorrência as divergências encontradas;

- Inspecionar, diariamente, os Setores de Enfermagem da Unidade, avaliando a qualidade de assistência prestada e identificando a necessidade de utilização de equipamentos e remanejamento de pessoal para prestação de atendimento adequado, bem como se as equipes estão utilizando o uniforme padrão da Unidade, com seus respectivos equipamentos de segurança;

- Orientar as atividades desenvolvidas pelos Enfermeiros Plantonistas, na realização de suas atividades diárias, bem como observando e orientando aspectos de desvio de comportamentos, a fim de corrigir os problemas com colaboradores no seu turno;

- Atender os clientes e seus acompanhantes, quando solicitado, esclarecendo as dúvidas apresentadas, bem como providenciando a solução aos superiores de plantão, caso o assunto fuja dos limites de sua autonomia;

- Garantir o cumprimento das Instruções Operacionais Técnicas e Administrativas do serviço noturno como: preparo pré-operatório, pré-exames, transferência de pacientes, conferência de material/medicação, requisição de farmácia, registrando as intercorrências e dificuldades encontradas no plantão no livro de Ordens e Ocorrências;

- Apoiar a Recepção de Internação propondo e encaminhando soluções inerentes a liberação de quarto ou leito, a fim de facilitar o processo de internação de novos ou transferências internas de pacientes;

- Acionar, quando necessário, o Setor de Engenharia Clínica, visando providenciar o reparo de equipamentos defeituosos na Unidade, durante seu plantão;

- Acompanhar e orientar situações de acidentes de trabalho ocorridos no seu turno, encaminhando os acidentados ao Setor de Emergência, bem como comunicando ao Setor de Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho as ocorrências;

- Intermediar situações que necessitem de auxílio a outras Unidades da Rede, obtendo autorização superior para os casos de: empréstimo de materiais e equipamentos médico-hospitalares, uso de autoclave e etc;

- Participar da elaboração de manuais de rotinas ou POPs, junto com as áreas de CCIH, Qualidade e Educação Continuada, a fim de contribuir para a implantação de processo de melhores práticas de assistência hospitalar;

- Testar materiais e equipamentos novos e responder pareceres técnicos enviados pelos setores de padronização e engenharia clínica respectivamente para análise e decisão sobre a utilização/aquisição.

Outras informações:

- Local de trabalho:

Barra da Tijuca - RJ.

- Escala de trabalho:

200h - 07h às 16h.

- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

title: Business Analyst
description:
A Oportunidade

A MyCareforce/Clicknurse está em um momento acelerado de crescimento, conectando profissionais de saúde a oportunidades de trabalho no Brasil e em Portugal. Já cobrimos +1.200.000 horas de enfermagem conectando +21.000 profissionais a +300 unidades de saúde. Somos uma empresa de tecnologia em crescimento (+€3.3M investimento) com uma missão clara: melhorar a qualidade dos cuidados de saúde.

Estamos buscando um Business Analyst com forte viés analítico para se juntar ao nosso time no Brasil.

Estamos procurando alguém com a mentalidade de um consultor estratégico – alguém que não apenas manuseie dados, mas que consiga mergulhar neles para extrair insights que direcionarão o sucesso dos nossos clientes (hospitais e unidades de saúde) e o crescimento do nosso negócio. Se você tem ~2 anos de experiência, preferencialmente em consultoria, uma capacidade analítica acima da média e fome de impactar um negócio em escala, essa vaga é para você.

Sobre a Função

Você reportará diretamente ao Head of Strategy & Planning , tendo alta exposição à liderança da empresa. Seu papel principal será atuar como o "motor de inteligência" da área, analisando dados internos e de mercado de ambas as geografias (BR e PT) para identificar onde podemos gerar mais valor.

Inicialmente, o foco será na geração de inteligência estratégica (back-office) para municiar os times internos - Operações e Comercial. No entanto, existe um caminho claro de evolução: à medida que você demonstrar senioridade e domínio do negócio, passará a ter exposição direta a clientes, participando de reuniões com executivos para apresentar suas análises.

Esta é uma posição com alto potencial de crescimento, podendo evoluir a médio prazo para uma posição de Gerência de BizOps, à medida que a nossa abordagem consultiva se torna cada vez mais central para o sucesso do cliente.

O Que Você Fará

  • Deep Dive Analítico: Realizar análises profundas e recorrentes dos dados operacionais dos nossos clientes para entender padrões de comportamento, gargalos e tendências de utilização da plataforma.
  • Geração de Insights Acionáveis: Ir além dos números para identificar proativamente oportunidades de negócio: como podemos aumentar o "share of wallet" nos clientes atuais? Onde estão as oportunidades de melhoria nos nossos serviços? Quais são as necessidades não atendidas dos clientes?
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Buscar, compilar e analisar dados externos de mercado (Brasil e Portugal) para complementar as análises internas e trazer benchmarks relevantes.
  • Comunicação Execuiva: Traduzir análises complexas em relatórios e apresentações executivas (Google Slides/PPT) que sejam claras, "insightful" e que contem uma história convincente para embasar decisões estratégicas.
  • Suporte Estratégico: Atuar como braço direito analítico do Head of Strategy & Planning, fornecendo dados rápidos e precisos para a tomada de decisão em um ambiente de prioridades dinâmicas.

Quem Você É

  • Experiência: Você possui mais de 1 ano de experiência profissional efetiva, preferencialmente em consultorias de gestão/estratégicas, ou em áreas de inteligência de negócios/BizOps em startups de alto crescimento.
  • Hard Skills Essenciais:
  • Domínio sólido de Google Sheets/Excel (você será testado nisso).
  • Conhecimento prático em SQL para extração e manipulação de dados.
  • Excelente capacidade de escrita e criação de apresentações estruturadas.
  • Mentalidade Analítica: Você é movido por dados e tem uma curiosidade intelectual aguçada para entender o "porquê" por trás dos números.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Você possui alta disposição para trabalhar em um ambiente de demanda intensa, com prioridades que mudam rapidamente. Você é autônomo, resiliente e tem senso de urgência.
  • Diferencial: Experiência prévia ou conhecimento do mercado de saúde (BR ou PT) será considerado uma vantagem.

O Que Oferecemos

  • Contratação modelo PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Possibilidade de Stock Options (equity) atreladas à performance.
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido na Vila Olímpia - São Paulo (3 dias presenciais, 2 remotos).
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com autonomia e exposição direta à liderança sênior.
  • Oportunidade real de crescimento acelerado e evolução de carreira (ex: trilha para Gerência de Estratégia e Operações).

title: ANALISTA DE FP&A SR - LONG RANGE PLANNING
description:

Modelo de trabalho híbrido sendo 3x por semana presencial em nosso escritório na Av. Paulista e 2x home office.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Technical Account Manager, Hybrid São Paulo
description:
About Us:

HBX Group is a leading B2B ecosystem player in the TravelTech space, connecting and empowering businesses in the ever-evolving world of travel. We drive growth for our clients and partners while removing friction from the end-to-end travel experience. Our cloud-based technology platforms offer fast and reliable access to a unique portfolio of travel products & services, while rich data and intelligence seamlessly connect supply and demand worldwide.

We have over more than 3,000 experts worldwide, including specialists on the ground who provide insights and support to boost trading even further, especially in the most hard-to-reach segments. This unique blend of technology, data and passionate people serves as a catalyst for all businesses aiming to unlock their full potential in the travel arena.

HBX Group comprises four best-in-class B2B brands that meet the needs of its growing and diverse client base across 190+ global markets:

• Hotelbeds, who cater for the specific needs of hoteliers, tour operators, airlines and online travel agents

• Bedsonline, exclusively serving the retail travel segment

• Roiback, the HotelTech partner for independent hotels and chains seeking growth through direct channel solutions

• TravelStack, providing all products, services and solutions to businesses looking to enter into the lucrative travel arena.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) with a strong technology foundation and a proven ability to deliver strategic solutions for enterprise clients. This role combines technical expertise with customer-centric account management , ensuring seamless integration, optimization, and long-term success for our most strategic partners.

As a TAM, you will act as a trusted advisor , building strong relationships with key accounts, driving technical excellence, and collaborating across global teams. You will lead technical engagements, oversee API client optimization, and provide proactive solutions that align with business objectives. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and is passionate about solving complex technical challenges.

Job Responsibilities

Territory Growth & Development

  • Partner with sales teams to position and deliver technical solutions to strategic customers through presentations, demos, evaluations, and technical objection handling.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for key accounts, ensuring smooth communication and integration.
  • Maximize product adoption and distribution from a technical perspective .

Solution Delivery & Optimization

  • Lead all technical activities related to customer onboarding and API integrations.
  • Provide post-sales technical support , troubleshoot issues, and resolve complex cases.
  • Analyze client performance and define optimization strategies to drive efficiency and scalability.
  • Develop scripts and automation tools to monitor, alert, and report on production environments.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Work closely with internal teams and external partners to align technical requirements with business goals.
  • Participate in global and regional projects , ensuring timely delivery and accurate reporting.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation and ensure KPIs are consistently met.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering , or related field.
  • Proven experience as a Strategic Technical Account Manager or similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, XML, JSON , and related technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Databases & SQL .
  • Understanding of automation practices across development, build, and deployment phases.
  • Familiarity with build management and CI/CD tools .
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, maintainable documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills , initiative, and ability to work in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience in the Travel Industry is a plus.
  • ADVANCED ENGLISH is a must

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.

You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones.
