Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.

Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas ("Overview Demos") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.

Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.

Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.

Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Company Description

Holy Koolaid is a YouTube channel dedicated to science, skepticism, and critical thinking . The channel explores topics such as archaeology, religion, pseudoscience, cults, history, and misinformation. Our goal is to create engaging educational content that encourages curiosity and critical thinking .

Role Description

Holy Koolaid Media is looking for a highly skilled video editor with strong motion graphics experience to help produce fast-paced documentary and explainer videos for YouTube. Our content explores history, archaeology, science, and critical thinking , often examining religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation through a skeptical lens. We are looking for someone who can turn research-heavy scripts into compelling visual stories using animation, motion graphics, archival footage, and creative editing. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and comfortable working with complex historical and scientific material . The position is fully remote , with occasional meetings in São Paulo preferred but not required .

What You'll Do

  • Edit long-form YouTube documentary and explainer videos
  • Create motion graphics and animations that help explain complex ideas
  • Cut footage to match script timing and narration
  • Add B-roll, archival footage, and visual references
  • Design and animate titles, diagrams, maps, and visual explanations
  • Add sound effects and polish audio
  • Work closely with the creator to ensure the visuals enhance the storytelling
  • Help research and locate visual assets relevant to historical and scientific topics
  • Maintain strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy and clarity

Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro (this is essential)
  • Experience with Photoshop
  • Experience creating motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to edit according to script timing and narrative pacing
  • Strong visual storytelling instincts
  • Extremely detail-oriented
  • Ability to research and find visual material when needed
  • At least 2 years of experience with motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with After Effects
  • Some familiarity with Adobe Audition
  • Experience editing YouTube videos
  • Experience with documentary-style editing
  • Interest in history, archaeology, or science
  • Comfortable working on content that critically examines religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation
  • English proficiency at B1 level or higher (flexible if editing skills are exceptional)

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate:

  • Thinks like a storyteller, not just an editor
  • Can take complex ideas and make them visually understandable
  • Is comfortable learning new topics quickly
  • Is curious and enjoys researching historical and scientific subjects
  • Can work with fast-paced YouTube content
  • Has the resilience and independence to figure things out and solve problems

How to Apply

Please include:

  • Portfolio or demo reel
  • Examples of motion graphics or animation work
  • Examples of video editing projects
  • A short note explaining why you are interested in this role

Applicants without a portfolio or demo reel will not be considered.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.

What You’ll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

· 5+ years in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

· Solution engineering capability in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

· You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

· Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

· Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

· Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

· Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

· Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product

Location & Working Hours

· Brazil-based ( fully remote )

· Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET) working hours

What We Offer

· Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

· Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

· Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

· High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

· Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings

How to Apply

Submit your CV  in English , and  one paragraph describing how you would approach the  first 60 days after a new client’s go-live in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Application Engineer
description:
You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

What You'll Build

Example products in the pipeline

· AI Candidate Matching Engine — Match candidates to job openings using semantic search, skill extraction, and intelligent ranking.

· Intelligent Onboarding Agent — An agentic system that guides new hires through credentialing, document collection, compliance checks, and first-day preparation. Replaces manual follow-up chains.

· Recruiter Copilot — An AI assistant embedded in recruiters' daily workflow. Surfaces candidate suggestions, drafts outreach, summarizes conversations, and flags placement risks.

· Conversational BI — Natural language interface to business data. Users ask questions in plain English, get charts, tables, and insights back.

What You'll Do

· Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources

· Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection

· Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications

· Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems

· Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality

· Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available

· Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically

· Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.

What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

· Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.

· Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it

· Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar

· Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management

· Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures

· Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)

· Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging

· Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)

Nice to have:

· Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops

· Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work

· Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)

· Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings

· Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services

· Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing

· Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or Azure ecosystem

Who You Are

· You graduated recently (1-3 years ago) and have already gotten your hands dirty building real AI applications in a real organization — internship, first job, startup, or contract work

· You're more of a builder than a researcher. You care about shipping products, not publishing papers.

· You're excited by the pace of LLM innovation and naturally stay up to date with new models, frameworks, and techniques

· You're comfortable with ambiguity. Some of these products don't have a playbook — you'll figure it out with the team.

· You're autonomous but collaborative. You can own a product end-to-end but also work closely with data engineers and product stakeholders.

Why This Role

· Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.

· Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.

· Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.

· Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

title: Senior Finance Data Analyst
description:
We’re building the future of how the world communicates.

What’s the scope of this role?

As part of Finance Global Business Support, the Senior Finance Data Analyst in the Business Profitability Management (BPM) group is responsible for delivering accurate, scalable, and actionable data products that support senior leadership decision-making. This role focuses on building and maintaining reporting, analytics, and dashboards for incoming deals and ongoing projects, ensuring transparency into bookings, revenue, margin, and profitability performance.

Will own data quality across source systems and reporting layers, create automated reporting solutions, and partner with Finance and Operations teams to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. This role blends financial understanding with strong technical and data skills to enable faster, more reliable forecasting and performance monitoring.

Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and recurring reporting for global bookings, revenue, margin, and profitability performance (Excel / Power BI / BI tools).
  • Own end-to-end reporting workflows including data extraction, transformation, modeling, validation, and distribution to executives and senior management.
  • Support monthly forecasting and actuals processes by delivering automated datasets, KPI tracking, and variance analytics (actual vs forecast vs prior periods).
  • Develop and maintain data models using Power Query, Power Pivot, and/or BI semantic models, ensuring consistent definitions and reconciliation with source systems.
  • Create executive-ready KPI decks and visual analytics; clearly communicate significant risks and drivers for bookings, revenue, and profit.
  • Partner globally with BPM managers/analysts and operational stakeholders to identify data issues, root causes, and required adjustments to properly reflect forecast and performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy and speed by implementing automation (Power Query, VBA, SQL, Power BI, workflows).
  • Define business requirements and support testing/implementation of ERP-based automated profitability reporting and analytics tools.
  • Establish and document data governance practices, report logic, KPI definitions, and process documentation to enable repeatability and auditability.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and create one-time dashboards/models for leadership requests.

What are the skills required?

  • Advanced Excel skills (large datasets, pivots, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, data validation, modeling) and ability to work with complex structured data
  • Strong experience with data transformation and modeling using Power Query and Power Pivot (DAX a plus)
  • Experience building dashboards and analytical reporting in Power BI or other BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, etc.)
  • Experience working with Oracle Financials
  • Ability to analyze large datasets, identify trends/outliers, and translate findings into clear business insights
  • Solid understanding of data accuracy concepts: reconciliations, controls, audit trails, and source-to-report validation
  • Hands-on technical skills with SQL (queries, joins, aggregations); VBA is a plus
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong organizational and time management skills; comfortable managing multiple priorities under deadlines
  • Self-starter, detail-oriented, process improvement mindset; ability to document processes and standards
  • Strong understanding of the business, with a proactive approach to identifying and anticipating needs
  • Effective use of task organization and prioritization tools is essential, including Kanban, sprint planning, and other Agile practices
  • Advanced/fluent oral and written English
  • Availability to work from the office in hybrid mode

Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, business operations, or finance analytics
  • Proven experience building automated reporting solutions, dashboards, and KPI tracking
  • Experience supporting forecasting/actuals cycles and working with financial/operational metrics (bookings, revenue, margin, profitability)
  • Experience working with ERP systems and extracting/transforming data from multiple sources
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Hands-on experience with Power Query / Power Pivot / Power BI
  • Hands-on experience in SQL and/or VBA; exposure to big data tools is a plus
  • Experience using Oracle Financials
  • Experience in multinational software/services environment is a plus

Education

  • BS in Finance/Accounting/Business/Analytics (or related)

title: Internal Communication Specialist
description:
About the Company

About Us: Keeta is an independent brand under Meituan, which is the world's largest technology-driven retail enterprise. We focus on food and consumer goods delivery services in the international market, and we uphold this mission: "Help people eat better and live better."

About the Role

This role involves leading the internal communications strategy, creating high-quality content, and enhancing employee engagement through effective communication channels.

Responsibilities

Internal Communications & Content Strategy

  • Communications System Building: Lead the design, build-out, and continuous optimization of the company’s internal communications system to ensure efficient information flow and full-employee coverage.
  • Content Planning & Creation: Produce high-quality internal communications content (e.g., all-hands emails/letters, values stories, campaign copy) to convey the company’s values and strategic direction through high-quality writing.
  • Channel Management: Operate and optimize internal communication channels/platforms (e.g., intranet, official accounts/newsletters) to improve reach and employee engagement.
  • Culture Content Packaging: Translate corporate culture concepts into vivid, highly shareable formats (e.g., short-video scripts, visual posters/graphics) to strengthen employee awareness and alignment.
  • Employee Feedback & Insights: Collect employee feedback through surveys, interviews, and data analysis; diagnose communication pain points, propose improvement plans, and drive implementation.

Employer Branding & Influence

  • External Communications & Content Operations: Partner with HR, PR, Marketing and other teams to create and distribute content via platforms such as LinkedIn (e.g., news, culture, employee stories, recruiting content).
  • EVP Development: Conduct research to understand how external candidates and internal employees perceive Keeta; structure and refine Keeta’s Employee Value Proposition (EVP).
  • Content Strategy Iteration: Analyze channel/content performance data to generate insights and continuously optimize content strategy and operations.

Globalization & Localization

  • Cross-cultural Communication: Coordinate with global teams to ensure internal communications align with a unified company tone while adapting to local language and cultural norms.
  • Multilingual Content: Lead the creation of English and other language versions of internal content to support information alignment across multinational teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or above; 5+ years of experience in internal communications, corporate communications, content creation, marketing, or related fields. International/multinational experience and familiarity with multicultural communication scenarios are a plus.
  • English as a working language; able to write high-quality English content and collaborate effectively in meetings.
  • Strong writing versatility (e.g., formal corporate writing, in-depth interviews/features, social/new-media copy). Proven “viral/hit” content cases are a plus.
  • Strong desire to have your viewpoints and writing seen and remembered by millions—driven to shape how people understand a topic or a brand.
  • Smart, highly communicative, strong logical thinking and interpersonal sensitivity; able to quickly understand diverse businesses, cultures, and people through deep interviews and research, and design outstanding communication strategies.

Role Highlights

A unique opportunity to closely observe a company’s growth journey, cultural foundations, and management approach—and translate them into compelling stories that can be seen across the industry.

Pay range and compensation package

Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Keeta is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life.

title: Senior JD Edwards E1 Developer (Brazil Localization & Integration Specialist)
description:
Full-time | Remote Primary Hubs: Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay

Secondary Hubs: Colombia, Chile

About Allari

Allari is a global technology solutions provider specializing in high-impact JD Edwards ecosystems. We value deep technical expertise and proactive problem-solving, helping our clients navigate complex regulatory and trade landscapes across the globe.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior JDE Developer who is a true "Hybrid" professional—an expert coder who deeply understands the functional logic of Brazil Localization and Global Trade Compliance.

In this role, you will be the technical anchor for a major Global Manufacturing client. You will be responsible for the seamless connection between JDE EnterpriseOne and external Fiscal/Trade engines (e.g., Thomson Reuters, Synchro, or similar). We need someone who understands the "plumbing" of Brazil localization—how data flows between JDE and external messaging systems for NFe, GFe, and tax calculations.

Core Specialized Requirements

  • Localization & Trade Integration: Proven experience managing the interface between JDE and external Tax/Global Trade platforms.
  • Brazil Localization Mastery: Expert knowledge of NFe (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) and GFe (Freight Management) workflows.
  • Fiscal Logic : A deep functional understanding of Brazilian tax calculation (ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS) and its impact on Procurement, Sales, and the General Ledger.
  • JDE Orchestrator : Advanced proficiency in building and troubleshooting Orchestrations (including Groovy scripting) for real-time external integrations.

Technical Skills & Experience

  • Core JDE Development: Expert-level mastery of RDA, FDA, BDA, TDA, and C BSFNs.
  • Integration Protocols: High comfort level with Business Services (BSSV), REST/SOAP APIs, and EDI/Flat File processing.
  • Modern Frameworks: Expert use of UDOs (E1 Pages, Watchlists, Personalizations) and BI Publisher.
  • Functional Awareness: Ability to act as a "Technical-Functional Bridge," understanding the business process flow behind the technical specifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Integration: Maintain and optimize the "connectors" between JDE and external fiscal/trade applications to ensure 100% compliance.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Provide Level 1–3 support with a focus on root-cause analysis and long-term architectural stability.
  • Collaborative Design: Partner with functional leads and business stakeholders to translate Brazilian regulatory changes into robust JDE solutions.

Languages & Education

  • Portuguese: Required (Native/Fluent).
  • English: Intermediate / Preferred. (We prioritize your technical-functional JDE expertise over absolute fluency).
  • Spanish: A significant plus (for collaboration across our LATAM footprint).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT/CS OR 10+ years of verifiable Senior JDE experience.

Apply with your CV in English.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
Please, send your resume in English. Only English resumes will be accepted.

Company Description

Valere is a leading AI application development agency that builds transformative, production- grade AI systems for modern enterprises. We partner with organizations to design, deploy, and scale AI applications that materially improve business performance. Our clients span mid-market to large companies who rely on us for elite engineering, strategy, and cutting-edge AI execution. As Valere continues rapid growth, we’re expanding our go-to-market team with world-class talent who can open high-value channels and partnerships—particularly within the cloud and AI ecosystem.

Role Description

Valere is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our growing Sales and Account Management team. This role is pivotal in driving our rapid expansion by generating new business opportunities and qualifying leads for our Account Executives. You will be the engine of our sales pipeline, focusing on identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective clients (primarily mid-market SMBs to large enterprises) who stand to gain significant competitive advantage from deploying our production-grade AI solutions.

This position requires a strategic mindset, excellent communication skills, and a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You will work closely with marketing, sales, and leadership to refine our outreach strategies and penetrate target accounts within the cloud and AI ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation & Qualification: Proactively research and identify potential client companies and key decision-makers across target industries. Qualify leads based on Valere's Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and BANT criteria (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline).
  • Outbound Prospecting: Execute multi-channel outbound campaigns to book qualified meetings and discovery calls for the Account Executive team.
  • Messaging & Communication: Articulate Valere's value proposition clearly and compellingly to prospective clients, tailoring messaging to specific industry and functional pain points.
  • Pipeline Management: Accurately track all sales activities, pipeline status, and customer interactions in the CRM (Monday) to ensure clean data and effective follow-up.
  • Sales Strategy & Alignment: Collaborate with Marketing and Sales leadership to optimize outreach sequences, A/B test messaging, and provide feedback on the quality of marketing-generated leads.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activities, and the evolving AI application landscape to better position Valere's services.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 1-3 years of proven success in a Sales Development, Business Development, or similar quota-carrying role, preferably in B2B technology, SaaS, or professional services (AI/Cloud experience is a strong plus).
  • Communication: Exceptional written English and verbal communication skills; comfortable and confident conducting outbound calls and presenting Valere's offering.
  • Grit & Resilience: A persistent, results-driven attitude with the ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive, high-energy approach.
  • Technical Acumen: Ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts related to AI, machine learning, and cloud infrastructure, and translate their business value.
  • Tools Proficiency: Hands-on experience with CRM software (Monday), sales engagement platforms, and prospecting tools.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience required.
  • AI and Automation Experience : Demonstrated experience using generative AI and workflow automation tools is a must.

title: Field Services Engineer
description:
Field Service Engineer – Steering Gear

Role Overview

We are looking for a Field Service Engineer to support our Steering Gear and Rudder systems. You will perform installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, commissioning, and upgrades, ensuring safe and reliable vessel maneuvering. This role involves both remote and on‑site support, often in dynamic environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and commission Steering Gear and Rudder systems.
  • Support customers during dry dockings, sea trials, and operational tests.
  • Provide technical assistance via phone, email, and on‑site worldwide.
  • Document service work, prepare reports, and update CRM/technical records.
  • Identify equipment issues, propose solutions, and ensure work meets QA and HSE standards.

description:
Let’s talk about Keeta

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan, one of the world’s largest delivery platforms. Our mission is bold: to revolutionize the delivery of food and everyday products across the globe. Our motto says it all: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With our Brazil launch approaching, we are expanding quickly and building a world-class team from the ground up. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex operational challenges, and want to make a visible impact, this could be the right opportunity for you.

We are looking for a Business Analytics Manager Logistics Optimization to support the design and continuous improvement of Keeta’s delivery dispatch system.   • Support experimentation cycles to test new operational parameters and measure performance impact

What We’re Looking For ✅

  • Experience in marketplace platforms, logistics operations, ride-hailing, delivery services, or e-commerce environments
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to diagnose operational challenges and drive improvements
  • Proficiency with analytical tools such as SQL, Python, or BI platforms (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and operational recommendations
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and operations
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Why Join Us

  • Be part of building and scaling a new global delivery platform from the ground up
  • Work in a dynamic environment where analytical insights directly influence operational performance
  • Collaborate with talented teams across product, engineering, and operations
  • Join a culture that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning

title: Analista de Ambiência - Temporário

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Contador (a) Sênior
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos uma empresa multinacional de engenharia e consultoria atuante em projetos de infraestrutura, meio ambiente e desenvolvimento urbano. Buscamos um(a) Contador(a) Sênior com sólida experiência em contabilidade geral, análise financeira, fechamento contábil, conciliações complexas - incluindo contabilidade de consórcios - e forte atuação em auditorias internas e externas.

O (a) profissional deve possuir profundo conhecimento das normas contábeis brasileiras (BR GAAP) e internacionais (IFRS), além de elevada capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, identificar riscos e propor melhorias nos processos contábeis e de controle interno.

Buscamos alguém com visão estratégica, que garanta a confiabilidade das demonstrações a nível local e corporativo a conformidade regulatória, e ofereça suporte técnico às áreas de negócios, finanças e controladoria. Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar e executar rotinas de contabilidade geral e fechamento mensal/anual.

  • Executar, revisar e validar conciliações contábeis complexas.
  • Garantir conformidade com obrigações fiscais e acessórias.
  • Elaborar balanço e demonstrações financeiras da empresa e de consórcios.
  • Atuar implementação, revisão e manutenção de controles internos.
  • Apoiar e acompanhar auditorias internas e externas.
  • Elaborar notas explicativas, relatórios gerenciais e análises de variações.
  • Assegurar conformidade com IFRS / CPC, legislações contábeis, políticas internas e diretrizes de compliance.
  • Contribuir para melhorias de processos e implantação /otimização de sistemas ERP.
  • Realizar interface com áreas financeiras, operações e stakeholders externos.
  • Apoio a auditorias internas e externas

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis com CRC ativo.
  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos na área contábil
  • Solida experiência em Contabilidade geral, societária e gerencial.
  • Vivência comprovada em contabilidade de consórcios.
  • Domínio de IFRS / CPC.
  • Experiência com ERP-SAP.
  • Excel avançado.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de engenharia, consultoria ou projetos.
  • Experiência com contabilidade de contratos de longo prazo (PPC / IFRS 15).
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol intermediário ou avançado.
  • Experiência com auditoria externa (Big Four ou similar).

Competências desejadas

  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade.
  • Capacidade de liderar, apoiar e desenvolver equipe.
  • Visão crítica e foco em melhoria contínua.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com prazos de fechamento.
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva, com bom relacionamento interpessoal.

title: Sales Account Executive
description:
Objetivo da empresa: Escalar o First Million de faturamento no setor de TaxTech . O Desafio

A Growthsale não é uma empresa de marketing; somos o motor de geração de receita de escritórios tributaristas de todo Brasil, através de um ISaaS especializado . Validamos o produto, o ticket médio e o processo. Agora, precisamos de um "Coach-Player" que coordene enquanto executa, alguém que tenha a "faca na caveira" para fechar vendas e a inteligência estratégica para otimizar o funil ao lado dos sócios.

Você não será apenas um vendedor. Você será um dos construtores da nossa área comercial.

O que você vai fazer na prática:
  • Negociações: Realizar reuniões de fechamento com leads qualificados (o processo já gera agenda previsível).
  • Gestão de Funil: Monitorar e otimizar fluxos de cadência, garantindo que nenhum lead esfrie.
  • Gestão (Coach): Supervisionar o seu SDR, ajustando o pitch e a passagem de bastão para garantir a qualificação e a máxima conversão.
  • Otimização Técnica: Sugerir melhorias no processo usando nossa stack ( ClickUp, Make, Chatbots ). Se você gosta ou quer entender de automação e engenharia de Go-To-Market, aqui é o seu lugar.
O perfil que buscamos:
  • Experiência: Cerca de 2 anos na área comercial, preferencialmente em Inside Sales (SDR, AE, Closer ou CS).
  • Mindset Builder: Você prefere criar o processo do que receber um manual pronto de 200 páginas.
  • Agilidade Tech: Confortável com ferramentas modernas. Não buscamos " dinossauros " do CRM de planilha, buscamos quem entende de produtividade.
  • Ambição Real: Queremos alguém que sinta "dor" por não bater meta e que veja o Equity como o caminho para mudar de patamar financeiro.
Por que vir para a Growthsale?
  1. Remuneração: Fixo de R$4.000,00 + comissão agressiva sobre as vendas (com metas extremamente acessíveis e pé no chão).
  2. O Upside: Possibilidade real de Equity (Partnership) ou PLR agressiva. Queremos sócios, não funcionários vitalícios.
  3. Mentoria de Elite: Vamos investir no seu treinamento técnico e comercial. Você vai aprender como se constrói um business de escala juntamente com os founders.
  4. Cultura: Ambiente jovem (média 23-25 anos), sem burocracia, focado em resultado e alta performance.
Pré-requisitos:
  • Conhecimento em Inside Sales
  • Metodologias vendas (SPIN, SPICED, BANT, Challenger Sales)
  • Familiaridade com os KPIs de vendas básicos.
Diferenciais que curtimos:
  • Conhecimento jurídico, contábil ou áreas correlatas.
  • Já ter trabalhado em startups early-stage.
  • Conhecimento (ou curiosidade técnica) em automações/Low-code.
  • Residir próximo ao Tatuapé.

Local: Tatuapé, São Paulo/SP (Híbrido)

description:

Perfil técnico esperado:

• Backend

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL utilizando Python (Flask) .
  • Integração de APIs com AWS Lake Formation e Amazon Redshift para processamento e consulta de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Implementação de regras de negócio e controle de acesso com AWS Cognito .
  • Atuação com AWS Lambda e API Gateway em arquiteturas serverless.
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, performance e escalabilidade em APIs.

  • Criação de dashboards e visualizações de dados com bibliotecas como Nivo ou Recharts .
  • Integração do frontend com AWS Cognito para autenticação e gestão de sessões.
  • Consumo de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL.
  • Garantia de responsividade e compatibilidade entre navegadores e dispositivos.

  • Proficiência em JavaScript e TypeScript .
  • Experiência com versionamento de código ( Git ).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados e conceitos de Data Warehouse / Lakehouse (SQL e/ou NoSQL).
  • Vivência com serviços AWS, como Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito e Amplify .
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban .

Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência com AWS Lake Formation e/ou Amazon Redshift .
  • Conhecimento em Strapi CMS .
  • Vivência com outras bibliotecas de visualização de dados (D3.js, Plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e).

Escopo de atuação:

  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções Full Stack conforme escopo definido do projeto.
  • Definição e sustentação da arquitetura técnica das aplicações.
  • Análise e otimização de performance e escalabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Apoio técnico e orientação a profissionais com menor senioridade no contexto do projeto.
  • Contribuição na definição de padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Produção de documentação técnica e apoio à transferência de conhecimento.

title: ANALISTA FRAUDE PLENO
description:
Sobre a MAPFRE

Você já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores seguradoras do mundo? title: Global HRBP
description:
About JD's International Business

We are committed to building a digitally intelligent cross-border supply chain and global retail infrastructure. Leveraging our global supply chain capabilities, JD continues to expand in markets where we possess distinct competitive advantages. Our diversified businesses—including retail, logistics, technology, industrial development, manufacturing, and healthcare—are growing in synergy. Currently, JD operates worldwide, with a presence in countries and regions such as China, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, serving customers across the globe.

Position Mission

As a core HR partner for our international expansion, you will be at the forefront of our rapidly growing global business. This is not just an HR role—it is a mission to become a "Growth Engine" and "Organizational Architect" for the business. We invest in your future through a unique 6-to-12-month immersive rotation program at our Beijing Headquarters. This program is designed to provide an in-depth understanding of our core business, culture, and operations, empowering you to drive organizational capability, build world-class teams, and ensure our people strategy accelerates our global growth.

Core Responsibilities

1. Global Talent Program: Beijing Headquarters Rotation (6–12 Months)

- Immerse yourself in the core operations, culture, and leadership network of our global business.

- Participate in structured training and mentorship while contributing to key projects in talent acquisition, organizational development, and HR analytics.

- Build a solid foundation and holistic perspective before transitioning to support international business teams.

2. Strategic HR Partnership & Business Insight

- Translate business strategies in international markets (e.g., Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, Middle East) into actionable people strategies.

- Provide forward-looking insights on organizational design, talent density, and cultural integration.

3. Talent Engine & Pipeline Development

- Lead end-to-end recruitment for critical roles in supply chain, warehouse management, cross-border logistics, and localized operations.

- Design and implement talent development initiatives such as the "Global Young Talent Program" to build a robust pipeline of future leaders.

4. Organizational Effectiveness & Team Activation

- Diagnose and optimize organizational structures and processes to enhance collaboration and performance in cross-cultural settings.

- Drive a results-oriented performance management system and leverage HR data to support business decision-making.

5. Global Culture & Employee Experience

- Champion JD’s corporate culture and foster an open, agile, and inclusive team environment across regions.

- Proactively manage employee relations and enhance the end-to-end employee lifecycle experience.

Qualifications & Attributes

We are seeking a future leader with business acumen, an entrepreneurial mindset, and high growth potential—not just a traditional HR practitioner.

Must-Haves

- Bachelor’s degree or above with at least 5 years of HR experience. Experience in internet, e-commerce, retail, logistics, or consulting is preferred.

- Global mindset: Overseas study/work experience or prior exposure to supporting international business is highly advantageous.

- Business acumen: Strong interest and ability to quickly grasp business logic, profitability models, and core challenges.

- Superior cognitive and problem-solving skills:

- Structured thinking: Ability to dissect complex situations and develop clear solution frameworks.

- Data-driven: Skilled in using data analysis to identify issues, validate hypotheses, and drive decisions.

- Drive & resilience:

- Ownership: Takes full responsibility for business challenges and outcomes.

- Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and views challenges as growth opportunities.

Core Competencies

- Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels and cultures.

- A keen eye for identifying and developing high-potential talent.

- Collaborative team player.

What We Offer

- A 6-to-12-month foundational rotation at Beijing Headquarters, connecting you with the core of our business and setting the stage for long-term success.

- A platform at the forefront of international growth, where your contributions directly impact our core strategy.

- Accelerated career growth by solving complex, real-world business challenges from day one.

- An environment of trust and autonomy that encourages bold thinking and innovation.

title: Viral Video Scout
description:
Turn Your Love of Viral Videos Into Income

Freelance Viral Video Scout (Remote – Global)

Company: Caters Media Group

Payment: Fixed fee per signed video

About Us

Caters Media Group is a leading international multimedia agency specialising in sourcing and licensing compelling video content to major global media outlets. We work with broadcasters, publishers and digital platforms around the world — and we’re always looking for the next viral moment before it hits the mainstream.

Many of our most successful scouts are people who already spend time discovering trending videos online. If you regularly spot viral moments before they explode across the internet, this could be an opportunity to turn that instinct into income.

The Opportunity

We are looking for motivated, self-driven individuals to join our global network of freelance Viral Video Scouts.

Your role will involve identifying compelling real-life videos online and helping us connect with the original creators so the content can be licensed to global media outlets.

Your responsibilities include:

Discover viral, newsworthy or emotionally compelling videos

Identify and verify the original creator of the content

Introduce creators to the opportunity to have their video licensed through Caters Media Group

Build rapport and, where required, speak with creators via phone or video call to explain how licensing works

Help secure signed agreements allowing Caters Media Group to represent the video

You earn a fixed fee for every video you successfully introduce that results in a signed licensing agreement.

No targets.

No fixed hours.

Work from anywhere.

Work when you want.

How It Works

You complete initial training with our team

We teach you what makes video content commercially valuable

We guide you on verifying ownership and introducing creators to the licensing opportunity

After training, you work independently identifying opportunities

You receive a fixed payment for each successfully signed video.

Your earnings depend on both the number of videos you secure and the quality and suitability of those submissions for licensing.

A fixed fee is paid once a creator has signed a licensing agreement with Caters Media Group for a video you introduced, and the video meets our internal quality and editorial guidelines.

All video submissions and creator agreements are subject to verification and approval by Caters Media Group before payment is issued.

This role is offered on an independent freelance basis and does not constitute employment with Caters Media Group.

What We’re Looking For

You don’t need formal qualifications — but you do need:

A sharp eye for viral and newsworthy video content

Confidence communicating with content creators

A strong standard of spoken and written English

The ability to speak with creators via phone or video call to explain licensing opportunities clearly and professionally

Self-motivation and initiative

Good time management

This role is ideal for people who:

Follow trending videos across multiple platforms daily

Enjoy spotting viral moments before they reach mainstream media

Understand the difference between original footage and reposted content

Enjoy identifying compelling real-life stories and moments

Are comfortable communicating with new people

Want flexible earning potential alongside other commitments

Are budding journalists interested in developing their news sense and editorial instincts

Work in journalism, media, or content creation and are looking to generate additional income alongside their existing work

If you regularly spot videos before they reach major news outlets, this role could be a strong fit.

What This Is (And Isn’t)

✅ Flexible freelance opportunity 

✅ Fixed fee per signed video

✅ Work from anywhere

✅ Initial training provided

✅ No fixed hours

✅ No minimum targets

❌ Not a salaried role

❌ No guaranteed income

❌ Not suited to those uncomfortable speaking with creators directly

Important

Due to the high number of applications we receive, only candidates who follow the application instructions carefully and complete the example task will be considered.

Applications that do not meet the requirements below may not be reviewed.

Application Requirements

All applications must be submitted in English.

Please include the following:

Attach your CV / Resume in English

Tell us which social media platforms you use most frequently

Explain why you believe you would be good at identifying licensable video content

Example Video Task

Please provide one example of a recent viral video that you believe could generate licensing revenue.

The video must:

Be posted on the social media account of the original video owner (the person who filmed the content)

Have been posted within the last 24 hours

Include a direct link to the video

Along with the link, please include 2–3 sentences explaining why you believe the video has licensing potential.

Ownership Check - In one or two sentences, explain how you have determined that the person posting the video is the original owner of the footage.

To confirm you have read the full application instructions, please include the word “Scout” in the subject line of your application email.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | 100% Remoto
description:
O DESAFIO:

A cada ano, o setor de saúde perde bilhões por falhas no faturamento. Nós somos o elo perdido que resolve esse gap com IA. Estamos em plena expansão , com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. Buscamos um Builder para transformar nosso produto atual em uma plataforma de escala global.

POR QUE ESTA POSIÇÃO É PARA VOCÊ?

Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas; não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.

Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico : da mão no código à tomada de decisão. É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:

• O Agora (Execução e Precisão):

  • Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.
  • Garantir precisão absoluta "batendo" dados e regras manualmente; em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.
  • Monitorar padrões de negativas ( denials ) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.

• O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura):

  • Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais .
  • Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.
  • Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios , utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.

O QUE BUSCAMOS:

  • Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.
  • Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.
  • Mão no Código: Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).
  • Mentalidade de Builder: Capacidade de construir sistemas robustos do zero e obsessão pelo detalhe (não descansa enquanto a automação não reflete a regra de negócio com precisão cirúrgica).

O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial: Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.
  • Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível: Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.
  • Equipe de alto nível: você encontrará pessoas fora da curva e nada melhor do que trabalhar com pessoas assim, né?
  • Flexibilidade e Futuro: Trabalho 100% remoto com possibilidade de participação societária ( Equity ) para quem constrói o negócio conosco.
  • Legado: você deixará o seu nome na construção, nos códigos e na história da empresa.

  • Strong English skills—comfortable presenting model decisions to stakeholders and writing detailed RFCs
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving data-science excellence and mentoring teams

Nice to Haves

  • Deep domain expertise in master-data management (golden records, lineage, MDM quality frameworks)
  • Experience building and governing enterprise-grade ML feature stores or adaptive rule libraries
  • Proficiency with SAP MDG and understanding of SAP master-data structures

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Missão do Cargo:

Responder pela coordenação e planejamento das atividades pertinentes à fabricação do produto em seu turno de trabalho, a fim de assegurar a melhoria contínua no desenvolvimento das pessoas e dos processos.

Principais atividades:

  • Garantir que as atividades executadas sob sua responsabilidade sejam realizadas conforme as normas de segurança, saúde, meio ambiente e qualidade;
  • Coordenar e acompanhar a operação da linha tomando ações corretivas e preventivas sempre que necessário;
  • Analisar os indicadores das linhas de operação e propor iniciativas para aqueles que estiverem com desvio;
  • Participar da elaboração e programação das paradas de manutenção anual, mensal e semanal.
  • Acompanhar a aderência do plano de manutenção semanal;
  • Participar e apoiar a área de manutenção nas paradas semanais, mensais e anuais.
  • Realizar análise e liberação de PT e ART como liberadores de área;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos programas de segurança para colaboradores próprios e terceiros quando necessário;
  • Participar e incentivar a utilização das ferramentas da qualidade/ melhoria contínua conforme procedimentos e políticas da empresa;
  • Garantir o nível de 5S das áreas e equipamentos.
  • Requisitos:
  • Ensino Superior Completo preferencialmente em Engenharia;
  • Experiência em processo produtivo de linhas de Moldura;
  • Experiência na área Industrial;
  • Experiência em gestão de processos e de equipes;
  • Experiência com processos de fabricação de Molduras
  • Pacote Office Intermediário;
  • Conhecimento de Ferramentas da Qualidade e Sistemas de gestão
  • Tomada de decisão com foco em segurança;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos de regime 6x1;
  • Disponibilidade de residir na região de Piên-PR e São Bento do Sul-SC.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Procuramos que Artificial Intelligence Engineer queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Nesta função você irá: (responsabilidades)

Construir e operar soluções de IA Generativa (RAG e agentes) robustas, seguras e governadas no Databricks, acelerando casos de uso de negócio de ponta a ponta — da ingestão e preparação de dados até a exposição via APIs e BI, com observabilidade, MLOps/LLMOps corporativo e governança centralizada.

Responsabilidades

• Desenho e implementação de GenAI/Agents: Co-criar soluções de RAG e agentes com times de negócio; definir NFRs e métricas de qualidade.

• Dados para IA (Lakehouse + Lakeflow): Preparar e versionar dados/documentos em Delta/volumes, indexar embeddings e alimentar features/artefatos com lineage capturado. Colaborar com Eng. de Dados em ingestão e pipelines com Lakeflow (Connect/Pipelines/Jobs).

• MLOps/LLMOps e Governança: Orquestrar ciclo de vida (experimentos, avaliação, prompt tuning/fine‑tuning, champion/challenger), revisões humanas (Review App), versionamento em MLflow e governança em UC (model registry, tags, políticas).

• Serviço, Observabilidade e Custo: Publicar modelos/agents com Mosaic AI Model Serving e AI Functions para batch/SQL; Implementar monitoramento (latência, custo/token, qualidade, segurança) e alertas.

• Segurança, Privacidade e Compartilhamento: Aplicar mascaras/ABAC em dados sensíveis (Unity Catalog), uso de Delta Sharing/Marketplaces/Clean Rooms quando necessário, garantindo auditoria e rastreabilidade.

• Arquitetura e Boas Práticas: Selecionar modelos base (Databricks hosted e/ou provedores externos), aplicar RAG patterns e guardrails, validar com benchmarking e avaliações automáticas (alucinação, precisão de recuperação, factualidade).

Habilidades Técnicas

• Databricks Mosaic AI: Agent Framework/AgentBricks, Vector Search, Model Serving, AI Functions, AI Playground/Review App

• RAG: chunking/embedding, avaliação, mitigação de alucinação e prompt engineering com versionamento (MLflow).

• Linguagens: Python e bibliotecas como Pysprk, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn e similares;

• Governança: Unity Catalog (model registry, lineage, masking, tags); Delta Lake (tabelas/volumes).

• Pipelines de dados: Lakeflow (Connect/Pipelines/Jobs) para ingestão e transformação de dados para IA.

• Serviços: Mosaic AI Model Serving (endpoints REST) e integração com aplicações/BI via SQL/AI Functions.

• Observabilidade: métricas de qualidade/custos/latência e logs de decisões dos agentes.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com serviços cloud MS Azure (Data Lake, Data Factory, Key Vault).

• Conhecimento de Lakeflow GA e Real‑Time Mode; familiaridade com a evolução DLT → Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines.

• Orquestração de agentes e pipelines usando plataformas Crew.ai e n8n.

• Integração com Atlan (linha de ponta a ponta até BI) e catálogos corporativos.

• Vivência com Data Mesh e governança federada de dados/IA

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.

What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity

Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices

Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects

Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Audio Producer II
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are seeking an experienced and driven Audio Producer II with a background in audio production workflows. This role involves cross-functional collaboration, and managing external partnerships to deliver exceptional audio experiences. This role will provide hands-on support in voice-over production tasks, music editing, and operational processes , ensuring smooth workflows between the audio team, internal, and external partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in voice-over production tasks, including communicating with vendors and internal local teams.
  • Communicate with internal and external partners to identify audio needs, plan execution, and ensure alignment from pre-production to delivery, acting as a key point of contact for audio-related matters.
  • Participate in the development of music, sound effects, and voice-over production schedules, ensuring alignment with multidisciplinary planning and vendor timelines.
  • Create comprehensive briefings for audio outsourcing partners, providing all necessary creative, technical, and production information.
  • Create, edit, and implement sound effects, voice-over assets, and other audio deliverables.
  • Mix audio content for publishing videos.
  • Ensure all audio deliverables meet project requirements, maintaining the highest quality standards across multiple projects.

Main job requirements:

  • Superior degree completed;
  • Proven experience (5+ years) in audio post-production workflow.
  • Expertise in audio editing tools such as Nuendo, Pro Tools, or similar.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills in English and Portuguese (written and spoken), with experience collaborating with internal teams and external partners.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with experience designing schedules and estimating budgets for complex projects.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving challenges.
  • Familiarity with generative AI audio tools (e.g., ElevenLabs, Suno).
  • Knowledge of middleware tools like Wwise or FMOD is a plus.
  • Passion for games or a strong understanding of gaming culture and player motivations;
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

- Please, make sure to share in your CV or Linkedin, the link of your portfolio/IMDB/Demo reel.

- Exclusivity contract required.

Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.500 colaboradores diretos.

  • Garantir a rastreabilidade todo o processo do controle de qualidade;
  • Revisar e aprovar certificado de análise de produto;
  • Demais funções pertinentes ao setor.

Requisitos:
